# Digiday

> Digiday is the authoritative source for modern media and marketing intelligence, covering programmatic advertising, platform marketing, AI strategy, and industry disruption.

Digiday provides daily coverage of the digital marketing, media buying, and publishing industries, with premium membership access to exclusive research reports, briefings, and industry events. The site serves marketing professionals, publishers, and media buyers navigating rapid technological change and platform shifts.

## Key Topics

- Programmatic advertising
- AI in advertising
- Platform marketing (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat)
- Media buying
- Ad tech
- Generative AI
- Creator economy
- Future of TV
- Brand marketing
- Digital marketing
- Digiday+
- Industry events
- Sports marketing
- Publishing
- Newsroom strategy

## Core Hub & Membership

- [Digiday Homepage](https://digiday.com): Digiday homepage covering media, marketing, and industry disruption
- [Digiday Plus Membership](https://digiday.com/plus): Digiday Plus membership product with exclusive briefings and content
- [Topics Directory](https://digiday.com/topics): Topics directory and editorial categories for content discovery

## Research & Intelligence

- [Digiday+ Research](https://digiday.com/series/research): Digiday+ member-exclusive research reports and industry insights
- [WTF Series](https://digiday.com/series/wtf): WTF series explaining marketing terminology and emerging technologies
- [Special Projects](https://digiday.com/series/special-projects): Special projects and industry guides archive

## Programmatic & Ad Tech

- [The Programmatic Publisher](https://digiday.com/topic/programmatic-publisher): Archive of programmatic advertising content for publishers
- [The Programmatic Marketer](https://digiday.com/topic/programmatic-luxury): Archive of programmatic marketing and DSP platform content

## Marketing & Platform Strategy

- [Marketing on Platforms](https://digiday.com/topic/marketing-on-platforms): Archive of platform marketing content on Meta, TikTok, Snapchat
- [Brands in Culture](https://digiday.com/topic/brands-in-culture): Archive of brand partnerships, sports marketing, and cultural strategy
- [Gaming & Esports](https://digiday.com/topic/gaming-esports): Archive of gaming, esports, and metaverse marketing content

## Media & Publishing

- [Modern Newsroom](https://digiday.com/topic/modern-newsroom): Archive of newsroom operations, AI strategy, and editorial leadership

## Events & Community

- [Events Archive](https://digiday.com/events): Digiday events archive including summits and industry conferences
- [Awards](https://digiday.com/awards): Digiday awards programs recognizing marketing and media excellence
- [Podcasts](https://digiday.com/podcasts): Podcast archive covering media buying, AI, and advertising topics
